metadata.description: Nohjen's marketplace of Claude Code plugins: skills, agents, commands, and hooks.

plugins.name: doc-generator
plugins.description: Generate or update project documentation from the latest git commit or a list of files. Produces concise, high-signal markdown that slots into an existing docs/ folder.

plugins.name: feature-brainstorm
plugins.description: Surfaces 2-3 viable options with project-grounded pros/cons and a recommendation when the user proposes a feature or change with a real tradeoff. Stops before implementation.
